cohort: 739 primiparous women attending regular check-ups at 36 or 37 weeks gestation, with live single foetuses in cephalic presentation
finding: A prediction model for arrest of labor in primiparous women at 36-37 weeks gestation was developed using six predictors: Bishop score, maternal height, foetal biparietal diameter, pre-pregnancy weight, maternal haemoglobin concentration, and amniotic fluid index.
